target.title: fix(skill-workshop): reject invalid proposal list limits
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`skill_workshop` proposal listing accepted malformed `limit` values by falling back to the default page size instead of reporting an input error. That made the runtime less strict than the tool schema and sibling list-style tools that require positive integer limits.

## Why This Change Was Made

The list action now uses the shared positive-integer parameter reader for `limit`, preserving the existing default when the field is omitted and the existing upper-bound clamp for valid large limits.

## User Impact

Malformed list limits now fail fast with a clear validation error. Valid list calls, omitted limits, and existing proposal listing behavior are unchanged.

## Evidence

- Head: `a7e8f9b40607ccf50f4c0f9f8424688a0154d3c2`
